title: Mega Man 6
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Rush Jet and Power are wearable adapters here. They replace normal weapons while equipped, and neither allows sliding. Change back to ordinary Mega Man for low tunnels.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.

Beat requires four letters awarded by the alternate boss rooms in Tomahawk, Yamato, Knight and Centaur. Clearing their ordinary room gives the weapon but not the letter; revisit if the stage box has no letter icon.
routeIntro: Plant first unlocks Jet; Wind and Flame then give Power. This route favors collecting the alternate-route letters, so Wind is another early Buster fight.

stages.name: Plant Man
stages.tip: Charge the Buster while his shield is up; shoot after he throws it.

items.name: Jet Adapter
items.text: Defeat Plant Man. Hold Jump in midair for a short flight, then land to recover its meter.

stages.tip: Stay away from the fan pull and jump over his crossing flight.

stages.name: Flame Man
stages.tip: Use Wind Storm between the pillars of fire.

items.name: Power Adapter
items.text: Defeat Flame Man. Charge its punch to break marked blocks and push certain objects.

stages.name: Tomahawk Man
stages.tip: Approach with Plant Barrier during a safe opening; avoid his thrown axes.

items.name: B letter
items.text: After the giant sun and Met dispenser, fly beneath the long central ledge with Jet. Follow the lower route to the alternate boss door.

items.name: Energy Balancer
items.text: Take the upper route above that same ledge. In the next ladder room, punch the lower breakable wall from the ladder to reveal the item.

stages.name: Yamato Man
stages.tip: Aim the tomahawk into his jump and dodge the falling spear pieces.

items.name: E letter
items.text: At the two-ladder junction, take the upper route using Jet and continue to the alternate boss.

stages.name: Knight Man
stages.tip: The spear penetrates his shield; otherwise wait for him to throw the mace.

items.name: A letter
items.text: Break the block beside the ordinary boss gate with Power, then follow the passage behind it.

stages.tip: Use Knight Crush between his teleports and jump over the shots.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Both Rush adapters + Energy Balancer + four BEAT letters. Refill tanks before Mr. X.

sections.title: Mr. X and Wily fortresses
paragraphs: Mr. X: use Flame Blast on the rail pods, Silver Tomahawk on the wall climber, Blizzard Attack on the Met tank, then Flame Blast on the swinging machine.
Wily: use Yamato Spear on the dragon and Wind Storm on the tank. Reuse the weakness chain during the rematches.
Silver Tomahawk reaches Wily’s raised targets in the machine and capsule fights. Power punches and charged Buster shots remain useful on reachable targets.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: The adapter’s flight meter is not ordinary weapon energy. Land on safe ground before crossing the next gap.
Energy Balancer assigns weapon energy to a depleted weapon when the ordinary Buster is selected.
